entities.summary: Anna Rosalie Eleonora Laurell Nash is a Swedish boxer. Laurell has won two World Championship golds, three European Championship golds and seven national Swedish championship golds in boxing. Laurell competed in the 2012 Summer Olympics in London after receiving a wild card from the Swedish Olympic Committee. She made it to the quarter-finals in her weight class.
